newsitem.title: USA: CSCE raises required deposits on spot coffee.
newsitem.headline: CSCE raises required deposits on spot coffee.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange (CSCE) said Monday it will lift the total deposit required for outright trades in its spot month May arabica coffee futures contract to $7,000 from $6,500, effective from the start of bussiness Tuesday morning.
A CSCE spokesman said the additional margin or spot month charge required on its May arabica coffee contract would rise by $1,000 to $3,000.
But the initial margin, calculated under the industry standard SPAN scan range would drop by $500 to $4,000.
These margins apply to exchange members or members of the trade.
Customers who are not exchange members or trade houses must pay 140 percent of exchange member margins.
The deposit requirement for the July contract will fall to $5,000 though, because of fall in the initial margin to $4,000 but the spot charge for July will remain unchanged at $1,000.
